name: Steamtech Final Dragon Weapon
text:
5 Level 13 'Steamtech' Monsters
Uneffected by other card effects. If this card Xyz Summoned Destroy all non-Machine monsters on the field. Once Per Turn: You can Banish 1 'Steamtech' Fusion or Synchro monster from your GY then target 1 monster on your Opponent's field, banish that target face down. If you have 'Steamtech Ultimate Dragon weapon' in your GY this card gains 5000 ATK.
